newsitem.title: USA: Texas Stock Index sets third straight record high.
newsitem.headline: Texas Stock Index sets third straight record high.

text.p: The Texas Stock Index set a new record high for the third consecutive month, State Comptroller John Sharp announced Thursday.
"The TSI rose 10.1 points in June to 366.9," Sharp said in a release. "That is 59 percent higher than one year ago."

By comparison, the Standard & Poor's 500, which tracks a nationwide stock price sampling, rose 36.8 percent, the comptroller said. Percentage-wise, the Standard & Poor's index rose 4.3 percent, while the TSI trailed, rising 2.9 percent, according to the release.
The comptroller's office produces the monthly Texas Stock Index to help monitor investor confidence in Texas-based businesses.
